title: Dark Mode Contrast & Map Zoom Stability Fixes
body:
- Enabled Tailwind class-based dark mode and updated question answer badges, blog post cards, and Map Border Hop error notices for high contrast in dark mode.
- Replaced the tiled map paper texture layer with a static viewport overlay so the map background stays steady without flickering while zooming.
- Removed the extra New target badge in Map Quizzes while keeping target-change transitions and clicked-region feedback.
